'''Plaza fountains''' were located within the [[Peacekeepers' temple|temple]] of the [[Peacekeepers]], a nonviolent splinter faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The last and greatest writings of the Peacekeepers were kept within a [[Hidden chamber|chamber]] underneath the plaza fountains.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Peacekeepers" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to investigate the temple. The companion discovered the hidden chamber beneath the fountains and subsequently delivered the last writings of the Peacekeepers into the hands of the individual who sent them.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The plaza fountains were mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "The Peacekeepers" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> The mission was initially only available to Republic players<ref name="TORhead">{{WebCite|url=http://www.torhead.com/crew-mission/bVJSnsn/the-peacekeepers|text=The Peacekeepers|work=torhead.com|archivedate=20150317013950}}</ref> though both this feature and the information about the mission's outcome are no longer in the game.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
